classroom_schoolbag.title: Your schoolbag
classroom_schoolbag.speaker: protagonist
classroom_schoolbag.text: Canvas, one strap, and the smell of pencil shavings. Two exercise books, a pen without a cap, a timetable folded twice. No biology textbook. You check the side pocket, then the gap behind the lining, which is where things usually end up. Not there either.
classroom_schoolbag.repeat_text: The same bag, the same pocket, the same missing book. Nothing has moved since you looked.

record.text: You searched your schoolbag. The biology textbook is not in it.

classroom_set_square.title: Wooden set square
classroom_set_square.speaker: protagonist
classroom_set_square.text: A set square the length of your forearm, laid on the corner of the front desk. The varnish is pale where a hand would hold it. One corner has split, and someone has taped it with tape that has since gone brown.
classroom_set_square.repeat_text: The set square, still on the corner of the desk. The taped corner faces the room.

recall.text: You remember this being put down on a desk. Twice, to be heard. You cannot say whether you were in the room when it happened.

record.text: A damaged wooden set square sits on the corner of the biology teacher's desk.

classroom_blackboard.title: Blackboard
classroom_blackboard.speaker: protagonist
classroom_blackboard.text: The board has been wiped, and then not quite wiped. Under the grey: LAST TERM — REVISION, and a date three weeks old. The chalk tray holds one broken stick and a clip that has lost its board.
classroom_blackboard.repeat_text: LAST TERM — REVISION, three weeks old, and a broken stick of chalk.

record.text: The blackboard still carries last term's revision heading and a three-week-old date.

classroom_window.title: Window
classroom_window.speaker: protagonist
classroom_window.text: Two panes, one cracked and repaired with clear tape. Below the sill: wet concrete, a low wall, a line of bins. The light outside is already the colour of late afternoon, and it is not yet nine.
classroom_window.repeat_text: The same wet concrete, the same impossible orange light.

record.text: The light outside the classroom window looks like late afternoon even though it is early morning.

classroom_own_desk.title: Your desk
classroom_own_desk.speaker: protagonist
classroom_own_desk.text: A name has been cut into the varnish with a compass point and then scratched out. A sticker on the corner, half peeled, for something you don't recognise. The front edge has a groove worn into it where a forearm goes.
classroom_own_desk.repeat_text: The scratched-out name. The groove in the front edge, exactly where your arm sits.

recall.text: You know the groove. Your arm has been in it for a long time. That is as much as you can say about it.

classroom_teacher_desk.title: Teacher's desk
classroom_teacher_desk.speaker: protagonist
classroom_teacher_desk.text: Bigger than the student desks and tidier by a small margin. A register in a plastic cover, a stapler, a mug being used to hold chalk. The chair is pushed in at an angle, as if the person leaving it had somewhere else to be first.
classroom_teacher_desk.repeat_text: Register, stapler, mug of chalk. The chair still at its angle.

record.text: The front desk is tidy in a way the student desks are not, and its chair is pushed in at an angle.

classroom_timetable_sheet.title: Timetable by the door
classroom_timetable_sheet.speaker: protagonist
classroom_timetable_sheet.text: A printed timetable in a plastic sleeve, with a coffee ring on one corner. Biology, Thursday, first period. The teacher's name is printed at the top, and somebody has drawn a line through it in biro.
classroom_timetable_sheet.repeat_text: Biology, Thursday, first period. The name is still lined out.

record.text: The classroom timetable lists biology first period on Thursday with the teacher's name lined out in biro.

classroom_door_blocked.title: Classroom door
classroom_door_blocked.speaker: protagonist
classroom_door_blocked.text: The handle turns easily. The corridor is out there, and the rest of the building with it, and you are supposed to be in a biology lesson that has not started yet. You take your hand off the handle.
classroom_door_blocked.repeat_text: The corridor is still out there. It can wait.
